categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Carries the 'Private Broadcast' label and extends transaction origin broadcast routing over Tor/I2P connections.
categories.rationale: Extends short-lived Tor/I2P private transaction broadcast to regular wallet transactions and rebroadcast cycles. The P2P rubric places privacy of transaction origin near the top of its concerns, and currently only sendrawtransaction utilizes private broadcast.

categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Carries the 'Wallet' label and modifies wallet RPC transaction submission and periodic rebroadcast handling.
categories.rationale: Enables wallet RPCs and rebroadcasts to route via private broadcast when -privatebroadcast is active instead of announcing to all peers. This provides substantial privacy improvement for wallet users by preventing node IP leakage, and centralizes checks before mutating wallet state.
